DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍食品の持ち運びについてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about carrying frozen food?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この冷凍餃子を買いたいですが、この後まだ一時間ほど用事があります。保冷袋だけで持ち歩いてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍餃子購入後に一時間の用事があり保冷袋で持ち歩けるか迷っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy these frozen dumplings, but I still have errands for about an hour afterward. I am unsure whether I can carry them around with only an insulated bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have an hour of errands after buying frozen dumplings and are unsure about carrying them in an insulated bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保冷の具合は時間や外の温度でも変わります。確実に凍ったままとは言えませんので、商品表示もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: How well they stay cold depends on the time and outdoor temperature too. We cannot say they will definitely remain frozen, so please also check the product label.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外は暑いです。先に用事を済ませて、帰る直前に買う方がよさそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外が暑いため用事を済ませ帰宅直前に買う方がよいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is hot outside. It seems better to finish my errands first and buy them just before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that because it is hot outside, it is better to finish errands and buy them just before going home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 買う順番を変える方法もありますね。お持ちの品がまだ会計前でしたら、購入を見送ることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Changing the order of your shopping is one option. If you have not paid for the item yet, you can also decide not to buy it.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ会計していません。この餃子はいったん買わずにおきます。元の場所に戻してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未会計なので餃子を買わず元の場所へ戻してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not paid yet. I will leave these dumplings for now. May I put them back where they were?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not paid, will not buy the dumplings now, and ask whether you may return them to their original place. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取り出してからの時間と状態を確認します。こちらでお預かりしますので、そのままお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check how long they have been out and their condition. We will take them here, so please hand them over as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 棚から出して五分ほどです。袋に水滴はありませんが、状態は見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 棚から五分ほどで水滴はないが状態を店員に確認してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has been about five minutes since I took them from the shelf. There are no water droplets on the bag, but I would like you to check their condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that they have been off the shelf about five minutes and have no water droplets, but you want a staff member to check their condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりして確認します。後で買われる場合は、冷凍品を最後に選び、帰宅後も表示に沿って保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take them and check. If you buy them later, select frozen items last and follow the label's storage instructions after getting home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、今日は常温の商品だけ先に買います。用事の後で戻れたら冷凍品を選び、直接家へ帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 常温品を先に買い用事後に戻れれば冷凍品を選んで直接帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then today I will buy only room-temperature products first. If I can come back after my errands, I will choose the frozen items and go straight home.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy room-temperature goods first and, if able to return after errands, select frozen goods and go straight home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご予定でお買い物をお進めください。お預かりした品はこちらで扱います。それでは、外の暑さにもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please continue shopping with that plan. We will handle the item you gave us. Take care in the heat outside as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料金のお支払いですね。用紙をこちらに置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are paying a bill. Could you place the form here?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨で用紙が濡れて、支払期限の部分がにじみました。この用紙で受け付けてもらえるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨で支払期限がにじみこの用紙で受付できるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The form got wet in the rain, and the payment-deadline part is blurred. I want to check whether you can accept this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the payment deadline is blurred by rain and that you want to know whether this form can be accepted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読み取りできるかと、表示される案内を確認します。用紙は一枚だけお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check whether it can be scanned and what instructions appear. Do you only have one form?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これ一枚です。同じ請求の別の紙は家にありますが、期限が同じか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手元は一枚だけで家の別紙が同じ期限か不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only this one here. There is another paper for the same bill at home, but I do not know whether the deadline is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only have one form here and do not know whether the other paper at home has the same deadline. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機械では読み取れませんでした。内容を推測して受付はできませんので、発行元へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The machine could not read it. We cannot accept it by guessing the contents, so please check with the issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。期限が過ぎたと決めつけず、発行元に使える用紙を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限切れと断定せず発行元へ使える用紙を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not assume it has expired; I will ask the issuer which form can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check which form to use with the issuer, without concluding it is overdue. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その際、請求番号など読める情報をお手元にご用意ください。こちらでは請求内容の変更はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: When doing so, have the readable information, such as the bill number, at hand. We cannot change the billing details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この紙は持ち帰ります。発行元の電話番号もにじんでいるので、別の紙で連絡先を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙を持ち帰りにじんだ電話番号は別紙から調べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take this paper home. The issuer's phone number is blurred too, so I will find the contact information on the other paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the form home and find the blurred phone number on another paper. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用紙をお返しします。再発行された場合は、古い用紙と混同しないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your form back. If a replacement is issued, make sure not to confuse it with the old one.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、家の紙と見比べてから問い合わせます。二枚とも支払わないよう、使う用紙を一枚に決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家の紙と比較して問い合わせ使う用紙を一枚に絞ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will compare it with the paper at home before asking. I will choose just one form to use so I do not pay both.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare the paper at home before asking and choose just one form to use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認が取れた用紙をお持ちください。それでは、雨で足元が滑らないようお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring a form that has been confirmed. Take care not to slip in the rain on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの案内状について、どこを確認されたいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the notice you brought would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日付が二つ書いてあります。相談に来る日と、返事を送る日を取り違えていないか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内状の相談日と返信日を取り違えていないか確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two dates. I want to make sure I have not mixed up the day to come for the consultation with the day to send a reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check whether you mixed up the consultation and reply dates on the notice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内状の見出しと、日付の前後の文を一緒に見ましょう。返信用の紙も入っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the heading and the words around the dates together. Was a reply form included too?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 参加するか丸を付ける紙がありました。上の日付が十日、下が二十日なので、十日に来るのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参加可否の紙に十日と二十日があり十日に来ると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was a paper for circling whether I will attend. The upper date is the tenth and the lower one the twentieth, so I thought I should come on the tenth.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the attendance form has the tenth and twentieth and you thought you should come on the tenth. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内では十日が返信期限で、二十日が相談の予定日ですね。参加希望を返す部分はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this notice, the tenth is the reply deadline and the twentieth the planned consultation day. This is the section for replying whether you want to attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十日までに返事をして、二十日が相談ですね。欠席に丸を付けた場合も、返送する必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十日が返信で二十日が相談と確認し欠席でも返送が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I reply by the tenth and consult on the twentieth. If I circle that I will not attend, do I still need to return it?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the tenth for reply and twentieth for consultation, and ask whether a reply is needed even for nonattendance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この紙の説明では、参加しない場合も返信をお願いしています。返信方法の欄を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The explanation asks for a reply even if you will not attend. Let us check the reply-method field.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信用封筒が入っていません。窓口へ持ってくる方法が書いてあるか、見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信封筒がないため窓口持参の案内を見てもらいたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is no reply envelope. Could you check whether it says I can bring it to the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Since there is no reply envelope, ask for the instructions about bringing it to the counter to be checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに持参の案内があります。提出先の担当名を確認して、受付場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are instructions for bringing it here. I will confirm the recipient staff member's name and guide you to the reception location.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当名を控えます。家で参加できるか確かめて紙に丸を付け、十日の期限までに指定の窓口へ持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当名を控え参加可否を確認して十日までに指定窓口へ持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the person's name. At home I will check whether I can attend and circle the form, then bring it to the designated counter by the tenth.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the staff name, check attendance, and bring the form to the designated counter by the tenth. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 日付を分けて確認できましたね。案内状も保管してください。それでは、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have distinguished the dates. Please keep the notice too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便物のお受け取りですね。不在票と確認書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are collecting mail. Do you have the missed-delivery notice and identification documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 両方持っています。不在票の名前が短く書かれていて、身分証の名前と完全には同じではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票と身分証があり不在票の名前が省略され完全一致しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have both. The name on the notice is shortened and does not exactly match the name on my identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have the notice and identification, but the abbreviated name on the notice does not match exactly. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表記の違いを確認します。ご自分のお名前の一部が省略されているということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the difference in how it is written. Do you mean that part of your own name has been omitted?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、真ん中の名前が抜けています。住所は同じで、差出人は私が注文した店だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 真ん中の名前が抜け住所は同じで注文先からの郵便と思うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the middle name is missing. The address is the same, and I think the sender is the shop I ordered from.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the middle name is missing, the address matches, and you think it is mail from the shop you ordered from. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 差出人の推測だけでは決めず、確認できる書類を見ます。注文に関する記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will not decide based only on a guess about the sender; we will look at documents we can verify. Do you have a record of the order?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 注文の確認メールがあります。こちらには身分証と同じ名前と、この住所が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 身分証と同じ名前と住所がある注文確認メールを持っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the order-confirmation email. It shows the same name as my identification and this address.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have an order-confirmation email with the same name as your identification and the address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者に受取時の確認方法を相談します。メールは必要な箇所だけ見せていただき、ほかの内容は閉じてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the person in charge about the checks for collection. Please show only the necessary parts of the email and close the rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前と住所の部分を開きます。今日受け取れるか未確認なら、先に条件を知ってから待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏名住所部分を表示し当日受取が未確認なら先に条件を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will open the name and address section. If collection today is not confirmed, I would like to know the conditions before waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the name and address section and say that if same-day collection is unconfirmed, you want to know the conditions first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受け取りに必要な確認と書類を整理してお伝えします。その結果によっては、追加の確認をお願いする場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will organize and explain the checks and documents required for collection. Depending on the result, we may ask for additional verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。不在票と身分証、注文メールを示します。追加で必要なものがあれば、メモして持ち直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三つの資料を提示し追加資料が必要ならメモして再持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will show the notice, identification, and order email. If anything else is needed, I will note it and bring it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the three documents and say that if additional documents are needed, you will note them and bring them again. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、表記を照合してご案内します。大切な書類はお忘れなく。それでは、お帰りの際もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will compare the names and advise you. Do not forget your important documents. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金機の前からお呼びでしたね。まだ確定操作はされていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You called us from the deposit machine. Have you not confirmed the transaction yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 確定していません。入れたつもりの金額より表示が少なく、どこを見ればよいか分からず呼びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 確定前で入れたつもりの額より表示が少なく確認場所が分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not confirmed it. The displayed amount is less than I thought I inserted, and I did not know where to check, so I called you.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have not confirmed, the display is less than what you thought you inserted, and you do not know where to check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面の案内を確認します。読み取れなかったお札についての表示は出ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the screen's instructions. Is there a message about banknotes it could not read?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 戻り口を確認してくださいと出ています。お札を入れ直してよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 戻り口確認の表示があり札を再投入してよいか迷っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to check the return slot. I am unsure whether to insert the notes again.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the display says to check the return slot and you are unsure about reinserting the note. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず返されたお札があるか確かめましょう。取り出す操作は、画面の案内に沿って行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let us check whether any notes have been returned. Follow the screen's instructions when taking them out.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚戻っていました。角が折れている千円札です。私が数えた金額との差は、この一枚分でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 角の折れた千円札一枚が戻り差額と一致したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One was returned. It is a thousand-yen note with a folded corner. The difference from the amount I counted was exactly this one note.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that one folded-corner thousand-yen note was returned and matches the difference. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 金額の差が確認できましたね。このお札は無理に入れ直さず、別の受付方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have identified the difference. Do not force this note back in; let us check another way to accept it.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、機械で入れる分を先に確定してもよいですか。戻った千円札は別に持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機械分を先に確定し戻った千円札は別に持つ方法でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then may I confirm the amount being deposited through the machine first? I will keep the returned thousand-yen note separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can confirm the machine deposit first and keep the returned thousand-yen note separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 画面の金額をご自分で確認してからお決めください。確定した場合は、明細と通帳などの記録もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the amount on the screen yourself before deciding. If you confirm it, also check the transaction slip and records such as your passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示された金額を確認しました。この分だけ確定し、戻った札は窓口で扱いを尋ねます。明細も取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示額を確認して機械分を確定し戻った札は窓口相談し明細を取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the displayed amount. I will confirm only this amount, ask the counter about the returned note, and take the transaction slip too.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you checked the display, will confirm that amount, ask the counter about the returned note, and take the slip. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 操作が終わってからご案内します。カードと明細の取り忘れにご注意を。それでは、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will guide you once the operation is finished. Be careful not to leave your card or slip behind. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池の前で何かお尋ねでしょうか。お子さまとご一緒ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question here by the pond? You are with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 魚を近くで見たいと子どもが言っています。持ってきた菓子を少し落として、寄ってきてもらってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもと魚を近くで見るため持参の菓子を落としてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child wants to see the fish up close. May we drop a little of the sweets we brought to make them come over?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may drop sweets you brought to see fish up close with your child. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べ物を勝手に与えるのはお控えください。園内の案内を確認し、魚を驚かせずに観察しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not feed them on your own. Check the park guidance and observe without startling the fish.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 菓子はしまいます。餌を使わず見るなら、池の縁まで近づいてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 菓子をしまい餌なしで見る際池の縁へ近づけるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will put the sweets away. If we watch without feeding them, may we approach the edge of the pond?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Put the sweets away and ask whether you can approach the pond's edge when watching without feeding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 柵や立入表示の内側へ入らず、通路からご覧ください。身を乗り出さないよう、お子さまにもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Stay on the paths without going beyond fences or restricted-entry signs. Please also tell your child not to lean out.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもと手をつなぎます。魚の動きをノートに描きたいのですが、通路で長く座るのは避けた方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもと手をつなぎノートに描きたいが通路に長く座らない方がよいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will hold my child's hand. We want to draw the fish's movements in a notebook, but we should avoid sitting on the path for a long time, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold your child's hand and confirm that you should not sit long on the path even though you want to draw in a notebook. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通行を妨げないようお願いします。観察は短くして、メモを書く場所も周りの案内で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please avoid obstructing passage. Keep your observation brief, and check nearby guidance for a place to write notes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、ここでは立って少し見ます。描くときは池から離れ、ほかの人の邪魔にならない場所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 池では短時間立って観察し描く時は離れて通行を妨げない場所を探すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then we will stand here and watch briefly. When drawing, we will move away from the pond and find a place that does not disturb others.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will stand and observe briefly by the pond, then move away to a place where drawing will not obstruct passage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その形でお願いします。池へ物を落とした場合も、取ろうとして水際へ入らず係にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. If anything falls into the pond, do not go to the water's edge to retrieve it; tell a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。菓子を出さず、ノートも袋にしまってから子どもと観察します。落としたら係に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 菓子を出さずノートをしまい物を落としたら係へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not take out the sweets, and I will put the notebook in the bag before observing with my child. If we drop something, I will tell a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep sweets away, put the notebook away, and contact staff if you drop anything. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 池の周りでは足元にもご注意ください。お子さまと穏やかに観察を楽しんでください。それでは、ごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Watch your step around the pond too. Enjoy observing calmly with your child. Take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 城跡の説明で、気になった言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any words in the castle ruins' explanation that caught your attention?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海城という言葉を初めて見ました。海の中に建物が立っていたという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海城が海中に建物が立つ意味か案内担当に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is the first time I have seen "sea castle." Does it mean the buildings stood in the sea?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the guide whether "sea castle" means buildings standing in the sea. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その言葉だけで建物が海中にあったと考えるのは違いますね。海との関係を説明する言葉として、展示の図も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is not correct to assume from that word alone that buildings were in the sea. Let us also look at the exhibit diagram as a term explaining its relationship with the sea.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 図では城の周りに水があります。今見えている水だけから、昔の姿を想像してよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図の水と現在見える水から昔の姿を想像してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: The diagram has water around the castle. Is it all right to imagine the past just from the water we can see now?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can imagine the past from the diagram's water and the water visible today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の様子と歴史上の姿は区別しましょう。資料に書かれた時期を確かめてから図を比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Distinguish the present condition from its historical appearance. Check the period given in the sources before comparing the diagrams.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この図には復元の想定と書かれています。全部が確定した形ではなく、資料から考えた部分もあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 復元の想定という表示から確定した形だけではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: This diagram says "proposed reconstruction." So not all of its form is certain; some parts were inferred from the sources.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: From the "proposed reconstruction" label, confirm that the form is not entirely established fact. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、説明にある根拠と推定の区別に注目すると理解しやすくなります。分からない部分は質問してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, paying attention to the distinction between evidence and estimates in the explanation makes it easier to understand. Ask about anything unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 堀と海の関係をもう少し知りたいです。説明がある資料の名前を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 堀と海の関係を説明する資料の名前を教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to know more about the relationship between the moat and sea. Could you tell me the name of a source that explains it?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the name of a source explaining the relationship between the moat and sea. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 関連する説明のある資料を確認してご案内します。私がここで言い切れない部分は、確認してお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check sources with relevant explanations and guide you. I will verify the parts I cannot state definitively here before telling you.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料名を待ちます。今日は海中の建物だと書かず、説明を読んで分かったことだけ見学メモに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料案内を待ち海中の建物と断定せず説明から分かったことだけメモすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the source name. Today I will not write that the buildings were in the sea; I will record only what I understood from the explanation in my visit notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the source guidance and note only what you learned from the explanation without asserting that buildings were in the sea. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料の確認後にお知らせします。歴史の言葉も一つずつ確かめてみてください。それでは、城跡の見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will let you know after checking the source. Try verifying historical terms one at a time too. Enjoy your visit to the castle ruins.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文を伺います。お二人分でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I take your order? Is it for two people?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人でこの盛り合わせを分けたいです。麺は一皿にして、つけ汁は別々にお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で麺一皿を分けつけ汁を別々に頼めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: We want to share this assortment between two. Could the noodles be on one plate and the dipping broth separate for each of us?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two people can share one plate of noodles with separate dipping broths. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取り分けの扱いを確認しますね。ほかに注文される品は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the arrangements for sharing. Have you decided on any other items?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 天ぷらを二つ注文します。つけ汁が一つだけ付くなら、もう一つは追加できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 天ぷら二つを注文し付属のつけ汁が一つなら追加できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will order two tempura items. If only one dipping broth is included, I want to know whether another can be added.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Order two tempura items and ask about adding broth if only one is included. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加のつけ汁の有無と料金を確認します。取り皿についても、必要な枚数を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether extra dipping broth is available and its price. Please also tell me how many sharing plates you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取り皿は二枚ほしいです。つけ汁の追加ができなければ、うどんを一人分ずつ頼む方法に変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取り皿二枚を希望しつけ汁追加不可ならうどんを一人分ずつに変えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: We would like two plates. If extra broth is unavailable, we will switch to ordering one portion of udon each.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request two sharing plates and say you will change to one udon portion each if extra broth is unavailable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望を厨房へ確認します。まだ注文を確定せず、追加の扱いが分かってからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the kitchen. Do not finalize the order yet; choose after you know the arrangements for extras.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、待ちます。二人とも熱い物はゆっくり食べるので、天ぷらを先に出してもらう必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認を待ち天ぷらだけを先に出す必要はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, we will wait. We both eat hot food slowly, so there is no need to bring the tempura first.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for confirmation and say that tempura alone does not need to be served first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提供の順番は厨房の状況も見てご案内します。つけ汁の追加について、確認できた内容からお伝えしますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will advise about serving order based on the kitchen's situation too. I will first tell you what we confirm about extra broth.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その説明を聞いてから決めます。取り皿二枚とつけ汁二つが用意できるか、まず確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明を聞いて決めるため取り皿二枚とつけ汁二つの用意可否を確かめてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will decide after hearing that explanation. Please first check whether two plates and two dipping broths can be provided.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for confirmation of two plates and two broths so you can decide after the explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、確認してまいります。ご注文が決まったら改めて伺います。それでは、お席でごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will go and check. We will take your order again when you decide. Please relax at your table.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自宅への訪問についてのご相談ですね。今、その方は近くにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a visit to your home. Is that person nearby now?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日のことなので、今はいません。点検に来たと言われましたが、予約した覚えがなく、少し不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日予約覚えのない点検員が来たが今はいないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: It happened yesterday, so they are not here now. They said they came for an inspection, but I do not remember booking one and feel a little uneasy.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an inspector you do not remember booking came yesterday but is not present now. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日はドアを開けたり、部屋に入れてしまったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you open the door or let them into your room yesterday?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ドアは閉めたまま話しました。名刺を頼みましたが置かずに帰り、会社の名前も聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ドアを閉めて話し名刺はなく会社名も聞き取れなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I spoke with the door closed. I asked for a business card, but they left without leaving one, and I could not catch the company's name either.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you spoke with the door closed, received no business card, and did not catch the company name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かっている状況を整理しましょう。お金を払ったり、個人情報を伝えたりはしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us organize what you know. Did you pay money or provide personal information?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お金は払っていません。名前や電話番号も言いませんでした。ただ、また来ると言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支払いも個人情報提供もなく再訪すると言われたと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not pay. I did not give my name or phone number either. But they said they would come again.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you neither paid nor provided personal information and were told they would return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次に来た場合も、身元が確認できないまま対応を進めずに相談してください。緊急の危険がある場合の連絡方法もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: If they return, do not proceed before verifying their identity; consult us. We will also explain how to contact help if there is immediate danger.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理会社にも、点検の予定があったか確認します。もし相手から番号を聞いても、それだけを頼りにしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理会社へ予定を確かめ訪問者の番号だけで判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check with the management company whether an inspection was scheduled. Even if I get a number from the visitor, I will not rely on that alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the schedule with management and not judge from the visitor's number alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 契約書など、普段から分かっている管理会社の連絡先を使って確かめる方法ですね。訪問時刻も控えておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can verify using the management company's contact you already know, such as in your contract. Please note the visit time too.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日の午後六時ごろとメモします。次に来てもドアを開けず、危険を感じたら案内された連絡先へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 午後六時頃を記録し次もドアを開けず危険時は案内先へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note around six yesterday evening. If they come again, I will not open the door, and if I feel in danger, I will consult the contact you gave me.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record around six in the evening, say you will not open the door next time, and will seek help through the indicated contact if in danger. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた事実をもとにご相談ください。無理に一人で応対する必要はありません。それでは、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Seek advice based on the facts you confirmed. You do not need to handle it alone against your wishes. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の状態についてご相談ですね。何が起きたか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about the condition of your medicine. Please tell me what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: かばんの中で水筒の水が漏れて、薬の袋が濡れました。中の包装にも水が入ったか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水筒が漏れて薬袋が濡れ包装内にも水が入ったか不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Water leaked from my drinking bottle inside my bag and wet the medicine bag. I do not know whether water entered the inner packaging too.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that leaked drinking-bottle water wet the medicine bag and you do not know whether it entered the packaging. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 状態を確認しますので、袋ごと拝見できますか。濡れた後に薬を取り出して飲みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see it with the bag to check its condition? Did you take out and swallow any medicine after it got wet?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ飲んでいません。包装は開けず、濡れた物だけ別の袋に入れて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ飲まず包装も開けず濡れた物を別袋で持参したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not taken any. I did not open the packaging; I put only the wet items in a separate bag and brought them.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not taken it or opened the packaging and brought the wet items in a separate bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま確認します。薬の名前と、受け取った日が分かる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check them as they are. Do you have a document showing the medicine's name and when you received it?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この説明書があります。三日前に受け取った薬で、今日はこれから飲む時間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明書があり三日前に受取り今日これから服用予定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have this information sheet. I received the medicine three days ago, and today's dose is coming up now.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have an information sheet, received it three days ago, and are due to take it now today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装の状態と薬の情報を見て、必要な確認をします。ご自分で乾かしたり、別の薬へ置き換えたりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will look at the packaging and medicine information and perform the necessary checks. Do not dry it yourself or substitute another medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。濡れた方を捨ててしまう前に、どれを使えるかと交換の相談が必要かを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 捨てる前に使用可否と交換相談の必要性を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Before throwing away the wet ones, I want to know which can be used and whether I need to consult about replacements.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that before disposal you want to know whether it can be used and whether replacement advice is needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 使えるかどうかをここで確認します。交換や再調剤が必要な場合の手続きも、確認のうえご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check here whether they can be used. If replacement or dispensing again is needed, we will also check and explain the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を待ちます。飲む時間が近いことも考慮して、次にどうするか薬剤師の方から教えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服用時間が近いことを踏まえ薬剤師から対応の説明を受けたいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the explanation. Since the time to take it is close, I would like the pharmacist to tell me what to do next, taking that into account.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the pharmacist to explain what to do, considering that your dose time is near. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 服用の予定も踏まえて確認します。独断で処理せず持ってきていただいてよかったです。それでは、どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check with your planned dose time in mind too. It is good that you brought it rather than deal with it on your own. Take care.
